CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(TEXT(Salutation)), "Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren", IF( TEXT(Salutation) = "Mr.", "Sehr geehrter Herr " & LastName, IF( TEXT(Salutation) = "Ms.", "Sehr geehrte Frau " & LastName, IF( TEXT(Salutation) = "Divers", "Sehr geehrte*r " & LastName, TEXT(Salutation) & " " & LastName ) ) ) )
CustomField.label: Letter Salutation
